description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of characteristics associated with a challenge benchmark for Large Language Models. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different characteristic: “Uncrushable”, “Unhackable”, “Complexity Instance”, “Scalable Oversight”, “Auto-verifiable”, and “Coverage General”. The slices are colored light blue, light green, dark blue, red, purple, and light orange, respectively. Each slice appears to represent an equal proportion, approximately 16.7% of the whole. Each slice contains an icon representing the characteristic, and the labels are positioned around the circumference of the circle. There is no explicit legend, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like explosion or bolding. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order around the circle.
